title: Safeguarding drinking water in north-western europe by modelling the fate of amines from CO2 capture
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,2922-2937
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07330H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
François Clayer, Cathrine Brecke Gundersen, Magnus Norling, Luca Pozzoli, Ashenafi Seifu Gragne, Tore Flatlandsmo Berglen
Modelling the fate of nitramine and nitrosamine from amine-based CO2 capture reveals significant risks to surface and groundwater, emphasizing the need for coordinated regional management during CCS deployment.
